# 1 Enoch Chapter 4 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of the Watchers

---

**4:1** And-again, observe-ye the-days of-summer how the-sun is-above-it [i.e., the-earth] at-its-beginning, and-you-seek shelter and-shade because of-the-heat of-the-sun, and-the-earth also burns with-a-burning-heat, and-you-are-not-able to-tread on-the-earth or on-a-rock because of-its-heat.

---

*EMET notes: Chapter 4 is a single verse in the standard Ge'ez enumeration, continuing the nature discourse with the observation of summer heat. The Ge'ez uses a vivid physical image — the ground too hot to walk on — to illustrate the faithfulness and power of the sun in its appointed season. No 4QEn Aramaic fragments cover this chapter.*
